title: Stuffed 2: Wipe It All Away - Character Bible
source: Derived from transcript analysis and synthesis observations

characters.name: Aggie

visual.original_form: Purple-furred female with white hair and light blue cap
visual.transformed_form: Plump bimbo-plush doll with exaggerated proportions, white hair, light blue cap, black top, pink underwear, often wrapped in striped sock tube

personality.motivations: Wants Chester to treat her like he treated Cumsock; craves intimacy and validation

behaviors.transformation_arc: Goes from frustrated/desiring → confused during magic → bimbo-plush form → satisfied/content

characters.relationship_to_chester: Roommate with unrequited romantic tension; desires his attention; becomes pliant/submissive after transformation

characters.name: Chester

visual.plush_form: Brown fur, pink hair, implied plush texture

personality.motivations: Watches TV passively; somewhat detached but participates when prompted

example_quotes: Uh, uh, it's, uh, The Duchess Betrothed. Heh.

behaviors.note: Rapidly shifts between original and plush forms - this is intentional magical behavior

characters.relationship_to_aggie: Roommate who takes Aggie's attention for granted; becomes sexually engaged after transformation

characters.name: Cumsock

visual.details: Pale pinkish-white round head, grey hair tuft, one yellow button eye (with black cross-stitching), one black eye patch, purple legs, large purple bulbous tail/sack, white fluffy wing-like appendages, wrapped in multi-colored striped sock tube

personality.motivations: Becomes sentient; acts as magical catalyst for Aggie's wish; delivers exposition through rap-like verses

behaviors.role_in_story: Magical catalyst; grants Aggie's wish through transformation

characters.relationship_to_aggie: Initially Aggie's possession (stuffed doll); becomes sentient ally who helps fulfill her wish

aggie_chester.power_balance: Aggie desires, Chester is passive until magically induced engagement

aggie_cumsock.power_balance: Cumsock gains power after sentience; guides Aggie's transformation
aggie_cumsock.intimacy_level: Physical proximity (wrapped around Aggie) but not sexual

chester_cumsock.power_balance: Implied dominance/submission from 'how he stuffed you'

states.name: original

chester.note: Shifts rapidly between forms - intentional magical effect showing Chester 'becoming like his dolls'

speech_style_guide.aggie: Use her name for Chester frequently. Include sounds like [groans], [giggles], [moaning]. Short, emotional phrases. Becomes more pliant/sexual after transformation.
speech_style_guide.chester: Hesitant, stuttering delivery ('Uh, uh, it's, uh'). Short responses. Ends sentences awkwardly. Minimal words.
speech_style_guide.cumsock: Verbose rhyming verses. Use slang. Address Aggie as 'Girl'. Confident, matter-of-fact. Deliver exposition through song-like speech.

scene_atmosphere_notes.dorm_room: Cluttered, cozy, mismatched blankets, anime figurines, lavender walls
scene_atmosphere_notes.lighting: Afternoon/morning light through window, lamplight glow
scene_atmosphere_notes.music: Upbeat during transformation, tense during buildup, intimate afterglow
